name: About this demo
info:
IoT Smart Factory demo (infra-dev-apps / DAP).

A packaging line with three machines: press-01 (hydraulic press),
cnc-02 (CNC mill) and robot-03 (packing robot).

- Line Simulator: publishes telemetry to factory/<site>/<line>/<machine>/telemetry
- Fault Injection: click the buttons, POST /api/fault, or publish to
  factory/<site>/<line>/<machine>/cmd with {"fault":"overheat|bearing|jam|none"}
- Analytics: rules engine raises alerts on factory/<site>/<line>/alerts and
  writes telemetry and alerts to InfluxDB (bucket telemetry)

Open Grafana (home dashboard "IoT Smart Factory") and inject a fault.
